title: Set up the office stack
summary: Email and docs on the company domain, the chat, wiki, doc storage, and tracker stood up, the aliases routed to real inboxes.

parts.title: Set up company email & docs
parts.guidance: Set up email and document accounts around the company-controlled domain, intended users and administrative ownership. Follow the workspace workflow to verify domain configuration, access and recovery before inviting the team. Connect chat, file sharing and aliases to the company identities, and assign any remaining migration work from personal accounts.

parts.title: Set up team chat
parts.guidance: Create channels for the team's actual work and announcements, set membership for public and sensitive discussions, and establish administrator and integration access. Check that new members can join the right conversations and receive useful notifications. Give the team a channel map showing where work, announcements and sensitive discussions belong and who maintains each channel.

parts.title: Set up a team wiki
parts.guidance: Start the wiki with onboarding, operating instructions and decision records people need now. Assign owners, review imported material and label unfinished drafts. Check that a teammate can find and update a representative page, then provide a stable entry point and link related instructions to their maintained source pages.

parts.title: Set up doc storage
parts.guidance: Organize document storage around actual teams, projects and access boundaries, identifying the source of truth for shared files. Use the storage workflow to test permissions and recovery before migration or broad invitations. Retain the folder or workspace map and outstanding migration issues, avoiding duplicate copies that obscure which document people should edit.

parts.title: Set up a project tracker
parts.guidance: Configure the tracker for the team's real work types, owners and definition of done. Bring in the initial backlog and resolve unassigned items or ambiguous statuses with the people doing the work. Walk a representative handoff through the tracker so assignment, status and completion evidence tell the same story.

parts.title: Set up email routing on your domain
parts.guidance: Map public addresses and internal aliases to the people or shared inboxes responsible for handling them. Review membership and forwarding destinations before applying routing changes. Use the email-routing workflow to test delivery and replies, retaining the configuration and ownership record so customer or operational mail has a clear destination and recovery path.
